points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake, README commands and configurable CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT are submitted; no independent clean build was run.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements the required solve --case/--output interface and explicit malformed-argument errors.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated config, IO, mesh, partition, physics and solver modules give clear numerical boundaries.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper was found. Trust policy forbids external similarity investigation, so originality is not positively proven.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Production path is JSON/CGNS driven; no case-name or two-mesh-only branch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbour halos are implemented. NACA M0.15 np2/np8 Cd differs 73.81% relative to a near-zero baseline (0.00089237 absolute), with differing endpoints and unbound historical binaries; rank-only causation and an order-one absolute change are not established. Re20 comparison is close. Score is provisional pending full review.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Exceptions, mesh checks, positive-state rejection and finite residual checks are present; no independent memory stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: A mesh diagnostic test and report/validator claims are present, but independent clean execution was not performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable, commented C++17 implementation; submitted report depends on generated_results.tex and raw result sources excluded from commit.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
